title: Portfolio evidence/readiness selection and Psychometrician source-first modernization

portfolio_selection.selection_rationale: Psychometrician combines the thinnest effective pool, high repeat risk, clear current PRC scope, four coherent official areas, stable authoritative sources, and high study-resource leverage.

official_scope.amendments: Resolution No. 02 s. 2023 superseded the 2014 TOS for examinations beginning June 2023; PRC 2026 schedule checked.

let.label: let
let.selection_rationale: Large effective pool and only a small residual depth/coverage gap.

civil-service.label: civil-service
civil-service.selection_rationale: Large effective pool; residual debt is not as coherent a source-first expansion target.

criminologist.label: criminologist
criminologist.selection_rationale: Recent authoritative/legal/forensic modernization materially improved readiness.

nursing.label: nursing
nursing.selection_rationale: Strong clinical evidence but recently expanded, with shared-science coverage residue and a stricter safety gate.

psychometrician.label: psychometrician
psychometrician.selection_rationale: Thin pool, high repeat risk, clear official four-area scope, strong stable source availability, and high study leverage.

civil-engineering.label: civil-engineering
civil-engineering.selection_rationale: Healthy recently expanded pool with known depth and coverage.

cpa.label: cpa
cpa.selection_rationale: Recent evidence closure left only a small residual question-depth gap.

mechanical-engineering.label: mechanical-engineering
mechanical-engineering.selection_rationale: Residual depth debt exists, but recent source-first expansion reduced the larger need.

registered-electrical-engineering.label: registered-electrical-engineering
registered-electrical-engineering.selection_rationale: Residual depth debt exists, but recent source-first expansion reduced the larger need.

architecture.label: architecture
architecture.selection_rationale: Recent large expansion and complete depth/coverage modernization.
